newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria budget gap down to 435.76 bln lvs June 30.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria budget gap down to 435.76 bln lvs June 30.

text.p: Bulgaria's central government budget deficit fell by some 10.28 billion levs in the second half of June to 435.76 billion levs, a Finance Ministry official said, citing preliminary figures.
"The deficit stood at 435.76 billion levs on June 30," the official told Reuters, declining to comment on the reasons for the fall.
Deficit at end-June was around 2.70 percent of the nominal 1997 gross domestic product (GDP) of 16.15 trillion levs assumed in this year's budget.

The central government budget deficit for fiscal 1997, which in Bulgaria coincides with the calendar year, was projected at 6.2 percent of GDP with revenues seen at 27.3 percent of GDP and expenditures at 33.5 percent.
Budget revenues at end-June amounted to 930.71 billion levs or 5.76 percent of projected GDP against expenditures of 1,366.47 billion levs or 8.46 percent of GDP. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 4145
